item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will be mainly fine over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. A band of rain and clouds will bring showers to Guangdong during the weekend to early next week.

Date/Month: 03/05 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4, force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 24 C
R.H. range: 50 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
